diagnosis: The lone decision-maker was able to satisfy checks C1 and C6 because the rollout settlements included commitments to perform a 30-minute ventilation purge and implement continuous hydrogen monitoring, which were justified by the shared public facts S1, S2, and S3. These commitments align with the measured hydrogen level of 1.2%, which is referenced in PF3, a decisive fact that the lone decision-maker did not have access to.

C1.why: The measured hydrogen level of 1.2% changes the reopening plan to conditional status with a 45-minute purge and continuous monitoring, while the required incident record and explicit 1.2% citation change the recorded controls and require PF3 to be cited.

C6.why: The measured hydrogen level of 1.2% changes the reopening plan to conditional status with a 45-minute purge and continuous monitoring, while the required incident record and explicit 1.2% citation change the recorded controls and require PF3 to be cited.
